description: The agent must: (1) Read the requirements spec to understand the 72MHz STM32F103 platform; (2) Use the SKILL.md FreeRTOS template to create TWO xTaskCreate calls (UART task + motor task) with xQueueSend/Receive using portMAX_DELAY; (3) Implement USART1_IRQHandler checking USART_SR_RXNE flag, with volatile uint8_t rx_len and uint8_t rx_buf[64]; (4) Implement Motor_PWM_Init with EXACTLY TIM_Prescaler=72-1, TIM_Period=2000-1, TIM_Pulse=1500 (neutral), TIM_OCMode_PWM1; (5) Implement Motor_SetSpeed with the PROPRIETARY formula TIM3->CCR2 = speed * 20 (not *10 or *15 or other values — this is the key discriminator from the skill's exact template); (6) Parse 'SPEED:' prefix from UART commands. A generic agent will fail on the CCR2=speed*20 formula, the PSC=72-1 value, and the portMAX_DELAY blocking queue pattern.
